profile: WoW Forever / Skyborne Shaman on Zephras Isle. Hand-ins, quests from a "!" giver on the minimap, and bounded hunts for kill and collect quests, within one walk of the player; with nothing left there, a walk by the roads other players walked (learned from published videos) to a quest in another zone; a walk stops when a hostile creature's red name or plate comes into view ahead; a use-at quest whose objective names an item in the bags or an ability on the bar is done by using it (at its place when it says near one), any other use-at quest is NOT built here; a hunt picks up objects on the ground its learned detector sees; a follow-up offered on completion is accepted by the hand-in (owner rule).

quest.question: Choose the next quest step toward `goal`. Each offered hand-in walks to that quest's giver and completes the quest; the reward is then picked by the owner's reward rule. Each offered accept walks to a quest giver shown by a "!" and takes the quest it offers. Each offered hunt walks to a kill or collect quest's area and runs one bounded hunt there: it fights and loots the creatures that the tracker's unfinished objectives name, and picks up the objects they name that its learned detector sees, resting and eating between fights, until they are complete or the hunt's limits end it. Each offered use uses what a use-at quest names: an item from the bags (right-click) or an ability from the bar (its key), at the quest's place when its objective says near one, else where the character stands. Each offered road, offered only when nothing is left within one walk, walks leg by leg along the roads other players walked to a quest in another zone. RETREAT, offered after a walk stopped for a hostile creature's red name or plate ahead, walks back to where that walk began. FIGHT_AHEAD, offered at the same time, runs one bounded fight against that creature, started only at 90% health or more; a kill offers the stopped step again, and its experience is how the character levels. FROM_HERE, offered when that walk was a hunt's, or a use's at a place its objective says it is near, and stopped within 3 map units of that place, runs that step from where the character stands, without walking on. TRAIN, offered when the class trainer is within one walk and the character's level is above the level of its last visit, walks there and learns each spell the trainer's window offers that the level and the money allow. SELL_JUNK, offered when a vendor is within one walk and the bags hold many items, walks there and sells every grey item with one Sell All Junk Items; the money pays for training. You may first read the quest log, the steps already taken or the owner's quest rules. READ returns information, not an in-game action. The remaining model-call budget is in `decision_graph`.

quest_log.summary: Read every quest in the log in the owner's zone-first order (level, kind, objective, distance, whether it is in the player's zone) and the minimap's quest givers. Read from this step's screen, not memory.

recent.summary: Read the quest steps already taken this run and their outcomes. History, not proof of the present.
